programme.title: 与谍同谋
programme.desc: 坐拥美容事业王国的卓君临(罗嘉良)两任妻子相继离世，剩下继女卓敏莉(黄心颖)共同生活，渐渐开始寻索人生的下半场，他遇见了足智多谋的年青人潘少杰(郑俊弘)，君临在他身上看见少年时候的自己，份外有一种亲切感，其贴身秘书陈唏文(李佳芯)也特别赏识这位新入职的市场部经理，确知他必能带领公司更上一层楼；唏文自丈夫康逸风(曹永廉)无故失踪多年，一直用工作麻醉自己，渐渐将君临和公司的一切成为她的人生目标。少杰表面积极讨好君临和取得唏文的信任，但背后与几位各有专长的伙伴，包括善长收集情报凌晋(张颕康)、社交能手邹佩瑜(汤洛雯)、科技宅女杜志仁(赖慰玲)和变装达人林信辉(胡诺言)，合作偷窃各大财团的商业秘密作为生财工具，已部署多年的少杰，正等待最佳时机发动一次摧毁性的报复行动，一场犹如父子的角力就在无形的战场上慢慢展开……

programme.title: 与谍同谋
programme.desc: 坐拥美容事业王国的卓君临(罗嘉良)两任妻子相继离世，剩下继女卓敏莉(黄心颖)共同生活，渐渐开始寻索人生的下半场，他遇见了足智多谋的年青人潘少杰(郑俊弘)，君临在他身上看见少年时候的自己，份外有一种亲切感，其贴身秘书陈唏文(李佳芯)也特别赏识这位新入职的市场部经理，确知他必能带领公司更上一层楼；唏文自丈夫康逸风(曹永廉)无故失踪多年，一直用工作麻醉自己，渐渐将君临和公司的一切成为她的人生目标。少杰表面积极讨好君临和取得唏文的信任，但背后与几位各有专长的伙伴，包括善长收集情报凌晋(张颕康)、社交能手邹佩瑜(汤洛雯)、科技宅女杜志仁(赖慰玲)和变装达人林信辉(胡诺言)，合作偷窃各大财团的商业秘密作为生财工具，已部署多年的少杰，正等待最佳时机发动一次摧毁性的报复行动，一场犹如父子的角力就在无形的战场上慢慢展开……

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 回归
programme.desc: 区耀祖(郭晋安饰)和邓丽娟(陈炜饰)离婚后，各自在香港、内地经营菜馆粤德居，多年来相安无事。2022年，丽娟突然回港开设分店，更扬言要透过法律途径争夺粤德居商标！两人的幼子区家健(周嘉洛饰)参加大湾区创业比赛，遇上了担任导师的哥哥区家谦(吴伟豪饰)，还有对手张莱(戴祖仪饰)，却从磨擦与打击中加深认识，并携手创建出元宇宙粤德居。实体店和元宇宙的粤德居同样被控侵权，耀祖、丽娟、家健、家谦面临不同难关，一家人之间的连系，又能否令彼此关系回到最初的幸福温馨？

programme.title: 肝胆昆仑
programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.title: 与谍同谋
programme.desc: 坐拥美容事业王国的卓君临(罗嘉良)两任妻子相继离世，剩下继女卓敏莉(黄心颖)共同生活，渐渐开始寻索人生的下半场，他遇见了足智多谋的年青人潘少杰(郑俊弘)，君临在他身上看见少年时候的自己，份外有一种亲切感，其贴身秘书陈唏文(李佳芯)也特别赏识这位新入职的市场部经理，确知他必能带领公司更上一层楼；唏文自丈夫康逸风(曹永廉)无故失踪多年，一直用工作麻醉自己，渐渐将君临和公司的一切成为她的人生目标。少杰表面积极讨好君临和取得唏文的信任，但背后与几位各有专长的伙伴，包括善长收集情报凌晋(张颕康)、社交能手邹佩瑜(汤洛雯)、科技宅女杜志仁(赖慰玲)和变装达人林信辉(胡诺言)，合作偷窃各大财团的商业秘密作为生财工具，已部署多年的少杰，正等待最佳时机发动一次摧毁性的报复行动，一场犹如父子的角力就在无形的战场上慢慢展开……

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 「回归光影颂」神奇的灯泡
programme.desc: 《神奇的灯泡》：一场停电，打乱了三个平凡人的生活。天性乐观的青年周港康(周嘉洛饰)、失意女编剧黎湘文(江嘉敏饰)、性格暴躁的郑忠(郑子诚饰)，为生活都当上了外卖员。三人各有抱负，却因某次停电而陷入困境。正当前路茫茫之际，三人得知世上竟存在着一个神奇灯泡，只要把灯泡燃亮，即可愿望成真！不过，灯泡只得一个实现梦想的机会，三人当中必有牺牲……

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 「回归光影颂」神奇的灯泡
programme.desc: 《神奇的灯泡》：一场停电，打乱了三个平凡人的生活。天性乐观的青年周港康(周嘉洛饰)、失意女编剧黎湘文(江嘉敏饰)、性格暴躁的郑忠(郑子诚饰)，为生活都当上了外卖员。三人各有抱负，却因某次停电而陷入困境。正当前路茫茫之际，三人得知世上竟存在着一个神奇灯泡，只要把灯泡燃亮，即可愿望成真！不过，灯泡只得一个实现梦想的机会，三人当中必有牺牲……

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: 与谍同谋

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……

programme.title: 溏心风暴3

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千桦饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，三女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，三角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Sunderland vs Brentford will be the 940th different fixture to have been played in the Premier League. They last faced in the top-flight in the 1946-47 campaign, with the Black Cats winning 3-0 away and 2-1 at home.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Burnley have won just two of their last 11 top-flight away games against West Ham (D2 L7) – 3-0 in March 2018 and 1-0 in July 2020.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Crystal Palace are looking to remain unbeaten for a 13th consecutive Premier League game, which would set a new club record for unbeaten top-flight league games – the Eagles also had a 12 match run between May and October 1990.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Newcastle have lost just one of their eight Premier League away games at the London Stadium against West Ham (W5 D2), and are unbeaten in their last six visits (W4 D2).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Between 2017-18 and 2023-24, Brighton and Hove Albion only avoided defeat in two of 14 Premier League games against Man City (W1 D1 L12); last season, they didn’t lose against City, winning 2-1 at home and drawing 2-2 at the Etihad.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Aston Villa have won four of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham Hotspur (L2), as many as their previous 29 beforehand (D7 L18).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Nottingham Forest are unbeaten in their last 13 top-flight home games against Leeds (W6 D7) since a 2-0 loss in November 1971 under Matt Gillies.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Crystal Palace are winless in their last seven home Premier League matches (D3 L4), last having a longer run at Selhurst Park in the top-flight between August 1997 and April 1998 (15 games).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Nottingham Forest have lost their last four Premier League games. They last lost five in a row between August/October 2022, while manager Sean Dyche has never lost five consecutively in the same campaign before.

programme.title: 十三太保
programme.desc: 故事讲述于唐朝年间，沙陀国主有十三义子，皆获太保衔。姜大卫饰演的十三太保为战场精英，因而引起兄弟间的嫉妒及挑拨离间，最后更演变成兄弟相残。

programme.title: 长辈
programme.desc: 家境富裕的大财主立带男为填房，为了避免那不可靠的侄子夺取家产，他在病重前立下遗嘱，更要求带男将遗嘱交给省城的另一侄子。当带男这个年轻长辈遇上侄子及他的儿子时，更闹出一连串的笑话。惠英红更藉此夺第一届香港电影金像奖影后。

programme.title: 广东十虎与后五虎
programme.desc: 广东十虎之一谭敏之侄谭聪，在赌馆当巡场；一夜，十虎的徒弟及后人等四人，在赌场相聚时，旗人佟七带着前清官之子小虎突袭，把谭聪杀死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、谭敏等，昔日曾把父杀死，以助反清义士蔡民义脱险。小虎遂与师叔们联手，杀死仍在世的十虎及其后人、传人，为父报仇...

programme.title: 五毒天罗
programme.desc: 《五毒天罗》是武林至毒之物，不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇坛主，要找出天罗所在，独霸武林，误放消息，谓天罗已重现武林，江湖一片风声鹤唳...

programme.title: 飞燕金刀
programme.desc: 总镖头李志山的妻子私通对头人龙震天，并设计先偷飞龙刀，再杀害李志山及女儿小燕，幸好最后李氏父女成功逃脱。小燕长大后，更成为武功高强的女剑客，誓要为死去的母亲报仇。直至一个偶然的机会，小燕遇到仍然在生的母亲，才骇然发现真相，原来自己一直被父亲的谎言所蒙骗。

programme.title: 花田错
programme.desc: 故事讲述千金小姐刘月英与丫鬟春兰同游花田盛会，邂逅桥边画画的落拓书生卞济。春兰眼见小姐芳心暗许，于是穿针引线，欲促成良缘，却因老家仆错认小霸王周通为卞济，使小姐与卞济情路波折重重。在经过一连串误会与错配后，结局乃皆大欢喜。

programme.title: 军阀趣史
programme.desc: 此片可谓李翰祥导演，经典作《大军阀》之延续，焦点在几位当时得令的艳星，余莎莉、邵音音及楚湘云。片中「艳趣」特别多...

programme.title: 万古流芳
programme.desc: 晋灵公宠信奸佞屠岸贾，时边关告急，相国赵盾启奏，反被屠岸贾挑拨，下令斩杀赵家三百余口。幸程婴抱庄姬之子赵武出走。屠下令杀全国男婴以断后患，程不惜以己子代替。赵长大，程以"雪冤图"告之，杀一家三百口仇人乃屠岸贾，更安排他与母亲相认......

programme.title: 英雄无泪
programme.desc: 江湖异人萧大师铸成宝剑「泪痕剑」，不料该剑显现出凶兆，将会带来武林浩劫，而他的亲生子注定要死在此剑之下。萧为了使此剑不危害江湖，将它交给一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。数十年后该弟子把它传给门徒小高，令其带剑下山望化解江湖劫数。

programme.title: 万花迎春
programme.desc: 歌舞团台柱陈君迈赋闲多时后，应征当富家女梅倩如的司机，竟被误传恋情。倩如为查明流言的来源，假扮记者采访歌舞团，期间君迈与倩如暗生好感，经过一番试探后，二人终一舞定情。

programme.title: 十字锁喉手
programme.desc: 李成鹰的父亲被多年好友凌豪设计所杀。李成鹰从父亲身上学会"十字锁喉手"的秘技，誓要为死去的父亲报仇。于是，他潜入凌家作护卫，期间也巧遇失散多年的兄长，两兄弟联手大战杀父仇人。

programme.title: 双镯
programme.desc: 两名少女作盟誓要在一个没有女权，甚或缺乏性自由的小渔村互相照顾一生。一位最终下嫁自己不认识的人，之后过着幸福快乐的日子。而另一位少女则惨遭许配给虐待成性的富家子，于是她唯有设法摆脱这个困境。

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龙门七侠」之首文素臣命六侠入昭庆寺探察，他们不慎被主持明空杀害。明空更设计杀害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潜入寺内与明空一战为六侠报仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭庆寺，联合文歼灭所有奸僧。

programme.title: 魔界
programme.desc: 故事讲述，警局侦缉部情侣探员郑忠与王丽芬同往离岛露营，半夜丽芬忽闻异声，离营探看，突见绿光一闪，随即着魔。翌日，王警官率众处理一宗挟持人质案件，期间丽芬径自开枪射杀劫匪，过程被杂志记者阿古摄得，发现子弹竟能转向杀人...

programme.title: 倾国倾城
programme.desc: 李翰祥史诗式电影，艺术成就及导演功力震惊中港台三地。本片荣获金马优等剧情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美术设计奖项。影后卢燕饰慈禧太后；处女演出即成名的萧瑶，饰死后受追封为贵妃的珍妃；而为珍妃逝世而不近女色的光绪帝则是狄龙。

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 年轻书生宁采臣在传说闹鬼的恐怖寺庙里过夜。虽然他不相信传闻，却遇上美丽的女鬼聂小倩。原来聂小倩被困在寺庙中，诱使年轻男子给魔头姥姥享用。宁采臣得悉聂小倩为一只善良的女鬼，于是决定助她逃离魔掌。

programme.title: 人皮灯笼
programme.desc: 赵春方曾于决斗败于龙帅之手下。七年后，龙帅为在赏灯大会上夺魁，往寻赵春方代为制造别致灯笼。赵春方藉此暗中布下复仇大计。龙帅之妻无固失踪后，他惊闻有关人皮灯笼的传说，并开始怀疑赵春方与失踪事件有关......

programme.title: 神经大侠
programme.desc: 威力无敌的兵器鸳鸯刀将要送给满清的皇帝，却不慎落入萧中慧和袁冠南手里。大内高手卓天雄于是出发追捕二人，誓要取回鸳鸯刀。大战一触即发，此刻鸳鸯刀的秘密也同被揭开。

programme.title: 徐老虎与白寡妇
programme.desc: 本片改编自高阳同名著作，获第18届金马奖最佳服装设计、最佳美术设计两项奖。本片讲述清朝食盐私枭徐老虎与白寡妇因清官李振彪拒不受贿，再加上责令严缉私盐，二人面临缉案危机。为免同僚落网，白独担罪责。徐悉白被处死，一心复仇...

programme.title: 保镖
programme.desc: 洛阳无敌庄庄主失去了所有功力，于是请来侄儿与未婚妻一起护送黄金前往京城。在途中，他们遇到了一名神秘侠客，三人随即联手对抗盗匪，竭力保护黄金不被劫走。

programme.title: 瀛台泣血
programme.desc: 清朝末年，光绪帝亲政后，开始着手维新变法，惜改革触犯了想保全自身富贵功名的官僚的阻扰。支持皇帝变法的康有为性格软弱，坚持变法的谭嗣同难免浮躁，光绪深知自己的处境危险，于是企图利用袁世凯去对付握有兵权的荣禄。但在关键时刻，袁世凯见风使舵却向荣禄告了密，出卖了光绪...

programme.title: 盗剑
programme.desc: 韩九重为夺削铁如泥的青霜剑，诱杀师弟谈鹤鸣；谈鹤鸣的妻子耿六娘隐姓埋名在将军府为佣，伺机夺剑报仇。将军女儿娇龙拜六娘为师，练成一身武艺，并与六娘师侄罗翼虎相恋。翼虎顺娇龙之意，深夜到亲王府盗剑，然而寡不敌众，失手被擒；娇龙率众营救，与韩九重等人展开连场激战。

programme.title: 小云雀
programme.desc: 记者仕泰为发掘歌星小云雀的秘密，假扮大亨接近小云雀。后来仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿，小云雀大怒，请来真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣赏仕泰的应变能力，实时聘请他为助手，处理歌星登台事宜。

programme.title: 十二金牌
programme.desc: 南宋年间，朝廷腐败积弱，加上金兵南侵，民生困苦。一代名将岳飞赤胆忠肝，率领岳家军奋勇抗敌，大破金兵，深受百姓爱戴。宋朝丞相秦桧卖国求荣，勾结金国四王子金兀术，设计对付岳飞，以扫除金人入侵中原的最大阻碍。宋高宗为保帝位，纵容秦桧只手遮天，更听从其谗言发出十二道金牌急召岳飞回京。岳飞长子岳云、次子岳雷与王八妹等江湖侠士，为挽救国家危难，千方百计阻截金牌，与秦桧爪牙爆发一场腥风血雨的死战...

programme.title: 洪拳与咏春
programme.desc: 清廷派人扫平少林寺，杀掉所有少林弟子。从中幸存出来的两名弟子，分别拜入咏春及洪拳师傅门下，学习拳法。最终他们挟技击败敌人，并为死去师兄弟报仇。

programme.title: 鬼画符
programme.desc: 周鹏被神捕诸葛森追杀，投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所杀，要求鹏二人带其鬼魂上路，到开封找公孙先生消灭杜鬼魂。鹏以大少奶的鬼符在赌场赢取路费，更与戏子吴顺超一同上路...

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼刘阿翠钟情以前邻居马素，欲与其结合，央求父亲携同金银珠宝向马提亲，撮合一段人鬼姻缘，马素年青憨直，不愿与鬼为伍，坚决拒绝，实则彼暗恋已有男友之邻居红卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，决定伺机行动。

programme.title: 镖旗飞扬
programme.desc: 凌霄及关望龙同为一流镖师，深得主人器重。关单恋主人孙女方燕，方却情系于凌。关迁怒凌，竟与黑道中人金不换密谋劫镖，嫁祸凌...

programme.title: 拳击
programme.desc: 范克在父亲临终时发现自己有一个同父异母的兄弟汶烈在泰国。于是，他去找汶烈，并发现他为了救治重病中的母亲，而成为一名拳手。两人相遇后，更被牵连在地下拳击赌博当中。

programme.title: Foraging consumers
programme.desc: At the Grand Parc orchard, customers are invited to pick their own fruits and vegetables. On their dairy farm, two brothers have set themselves the challenge of producing better while reducing their CO2 emissions. All about the largest mammal living in Normandy: the deer.

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Levy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: La Vie a Velo
programme.desc: Throughout France, more than twenty million people use bicycles daily. Marion Rousse, a champion road cyclist, meets those for whom this means of transportation has become essential in their personal and professional lives.

programme.title: Around Bell Pepper
programme.desc: The chef highlights bell peppers with a hot dish and a salad: stuffed shells with cottage cheese and spinach in roasted pepper sauce, and a preparation with grilled peppers and zucchini.

programme.title: Special Renovations
programme.desc: Anne-Catherine Verwaerde visits Emmanuel in the Landes and Tiphaine in the North to admire the renovations carried out in their homes.

programme.title: The Reflesherator / Master Blister
programme.desc: The Reflesherator When Professor Burns requires a substitute teacher, Flyboy's dad volunteers for the job. Master Blister The students of Scare School are thrilled after a prank played on Alder and Dash results in their firing.

programme.title: Casper The Match Maker / Jimmy Bradley: Creature Catcher
programme.desc: Casper, the Match Maker When Frankengymteacher gets extra crabby, the kids realize he's secretly in love with their history teacher, Hedy. Jimmy Bradley: Creature Catcher On “take your kid to work day,” Jimmy's dad invites him to tag along as a junior ghost catcher.

programme.title: Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: The Yarn Fairy / Bake It ‘Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think they're a mysterious "Yarn Fairy," and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves. / When Marcus and Harper team-up for a school project, they decide to bake something ("It's like inventing, but with food!"), only to come across multiple baking missha

programme.title: Things That Go Bump / Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When "something" starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus' house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that it's a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. / Lola isn't very good at “Hide & Seek” so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now she’s going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: A Cat-Tabulous Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in the dollhouse! After putting the final topper on the Christmas tree, Figgy the Elf calls and says that Santa Kitty needs help in his workshop, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go help her out. After some toy fixing and boxing fun, Gabby and Pandy get to meet Santa Kitty and his Kitty reindeer and join him delivering presents to all their friends in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: Hippo Lake
programme.desc: When Gloria sneaks into the NY Ballet to audition for “Swan Lake” and gets rejected (not for her dancing, but because she’s a hippo), Gloria’s belief in herself is tested.

programme.title: Best Fans Forever
programme.desc: The gang heads to “Best Fans Day” at NY’s Giraffe Stadium, where Alex gets caught up in the attention of rooting for the winning team. When his behavior ends up hurting Marty’s feelings, Alex comes to learn that the only team that matters is the one that’s made up of his friends.

programme.title: Somewhere / Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. Kelp tells his family he’s a unicorn. / Kelp returns to Unicorn Land where he meets Pixie and Juniper, who show him around and introduce him to unicorn spark and magic.

programme.title: Tacos / Rainy Day
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. / Kelp’s unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. But it rains and the game is called off until Kelp shows them that playing in the water can be even more fun.

programme.title: Dog the Right Thing
programme.desc: In preparation for the big race to determine the next Race Cadets, Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to build their own cars. The catch? The car parts are scattered throughout Pawston. \ The Not Yet Cadets compete in the final race to see which team will join the Race Cadets.

programme.title: All Paws on Deck / Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paw’s anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. \ Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawston’s 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Lost and Found / In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. / Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Longest Yardwork / The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. / Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Home Alone
programme.desc: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

programme.title: Slobber Power
programme.desc: Cutter gets a chance to be a "mom" when a newly hatched dragon bonds with him, and they'll both be needed to get the others out of a tangled mess.

programme.title: Dollhouse Detectives
programme.desc: There's a mystery in the dollhouse! When things start to mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy play detectives, using all their senses to find clues, follow them, and solve the mystery. For our COTD segment, CatRat and Baby Me-Owls show us how to make ice cube paints!

programme.title: Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Biggest Fan/ Queen Isabella
programme.desc: Shelby, Peabody & Sherman's biggest fan, accidentally gets sucked into the show; Queen Isabella falls for a scam and loses all her money.

programme.title: Peabody's Parents/ Galileo
programme.desc: Peabody's non-talking dog parents arrive for an unexpected visit; Galileo makes the world go dark when he crashes his spaceship and breaks the sun.

programme.title: Boots
programme.desc: Jack Sprat steals enchanted boots from the Treasure House and triggers a dangerous Devil Wind that threatens to consume San Lorenzo's treasure.

programme.title: Sword
programme.desc: Dulcinea pulls a magical sword from a stone and becomes enchanted with heroic powers; Puss must help her learn how to control her newfound strength.

programme.title: Out of the Cave and Onto Thin Ice
programme.desc: After a shocking revelation, Po is determined to get his chi back and Jing decides to face Jindiao

programme.title: Return of the Four Constellations
programme.desc: The kids go to the Spirit Realm and meet the Original Four Constellations in the hopes of learning how to defeat Jindiao

programme.title: A Rider's Balance
programme.desc: After meeting her riding idols, Pru vows to practice until she's perfect — even if it means missing out on a bonfire her best friends are planning.

programme.title: Welcome Back Otter
programme.desc: Abigail puts herself at risk to reunite an orphaned otter with his family. But the school veterinarian insists the animal will be safer at the zoo.

programme.title: Ragnarok: Part 2
programme.desc: After a major miscalculation by Tom in 225 leaves the fate of the Realms in jeopardy, Jun and the riders rally behind Tom and Thunder to face off against the World Serpent.

programme.title: Hobs and Saw
programme.desc: When Phil threatens to shut down D’Angelo’s new dragon hospital and ban dragons from ICARIS, D’Angelo and a little Hobgobbler have to change his mind.

programme.title: Hearts of Heroes
programme.desc: While Tom struggles with admitting his feelings for Jun, the pair find themselves trapped inside a giant tree with an anxious colony of Woodchipper dragons.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Angry Abnormal Atrocities of the Astute Animal Agressors
programme.desc: Stuck in separate camps, Harold and George unleash a hyperintelligent talking possum to scare the pants off of Krupp. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Abysmal Altercation of the Abominable Altitooth
programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Bout of the Beastly Barfilisk
programme.desc: Harold and George don't ask for much -- just a fun scavenger hunt that doesn't include doing Krupp's errands. Careful what you wish for, fellas.

programme.title: Straycation Part II
programme.desc: While the parents are away, the kids are in charge of the tree house, but when the punch monkeys invade the house, the kids find themselves out of their element.

programme.title: Thunder Misters
programme.desc: Jealous of the Thunder Sisters, the men on the farm undergo a series of difficult initiation rituals to try and join the exclusive tribe of women.

programme.title: Eep Walking
programme.desc: Eep loves action and adventure - it's in her blood. But when Eep starts adventuring in her sleep, she has to try to find the cause of her new sleep walking to avoid ending up in dangerous situations.

programme.title: Ragnarok: Part 2
programme.desc: After a major miscalculation by Tom in 225 leaves the fate of the Realms in jeopardy, Jun and the riders rally behind Tom and Thunder to face off against the World Serpent.

programme.title: Hobs and Saw
programme.desc: When Phil threatens to shut down D’Angelo’s new dragon hospital and ban dragons from ICARIS, D’Angelo and a little Hobgobbler have to change his mind.

programme.title: Hearts of Heroes
programme.desc: While Tom struggles with admitting his feelings for Jun, the pair find themselves trapped inside a giant tree with an anxious colony of Woodchipper dragons.

programme.title: Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayesh's wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Return Of The Trollhunter
programme.desc: Jim yearns to save Claires brother Meanwhile Strickler takes a field trip to find help in his quest for power

programme.title: Mudslinging
programme.desc: Jim is nominated for Spring Fling King Meanwhile Strickler brings Angor Rot to Arcadia so the Troll assassin can meet his prey.

programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】长安新帝登基动荡之际，卢凌风、苏无名伪装护送金桃归京，在酥山店布下情报网，破解哭寺、白泽、食尾蛇等诡案，捜金桃至马球致命阴谋，公主争锋下生死一线。

programme.title: 中国新闻
programme.desc: 《中国新闻》是以海外华人华侨、港澳台同胞、留学生、驻外使领馆及中资机构人员为目标受众的综合性新闻栏目。栏目由国内外要闻、中国内地经济和社会新闻、对国内外重要新闻事件的分析和评论组成。

programme.title: 今日关注
programme.desc: 《今日关注》紧密跟踪国内外重大新闻事件、新闻话题，邀请国内外一流的专家和高级官员，梳理新闻来龙去脉，分析新闻背后的新闻，评论新闻事件的影响和发展趋势。

programme.title: 国家记忆
programme.desc: 中国第一档国史节目，展现党史、国史、军史中的重大历史事件、各领域重大工程建设、揭秘重大决策背后的故事、讲述各阶层各时代代表性人物，记录讲述党的奋斗史、创业史、中国特色社会主义探索史、改革开放进程史。

programme.title: 走遍中国
programme.desc: 主要以中国的某一城市（或地域、或主题）为选题范围，选取其最具的历史传承、风土人情、杰出人物、自然风光和发展变化以连续一周每天30分钟播出的大容量，向世界全景式地展现新世纪的中国城市（或地域）形象。

programme.title: 海峡两岸
programme.desc: 节目宗旨是"跟踪海峡热点，反映两岸民意"，节目分为两个版块：第一个是"热点扫描"，主要报道当日的近期台湾岛内的热点新闻；第二个是"热点透视"，当日或近期涉台热点深度报道及两岸专家对此事的评论，并对两岸各个层面的交流交往进行跟踪报道。
